ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Team and Reviewers,
Thank you for your continued feedback and support throughout this process.
We are pleased to submit our Proof of Achievement (PoA) for Milestone 1 of Cardano Unleashed. This submission reflects the updated and officially approved milestone wording related to our NFT activity and integrates all supporting documentation from our completed outputs.
NFT Milestone (Updated and Approved Wording):
“A minimum of 45 NFT-enabled NFC cards distributed and demonstrated to attendees during the launch event for prototype testing purposes, with documentation of onboarding, feedback, and challenges related to Cardano blockchain interaction, supported by a local wallet partner.”Summary of NFT Activity:
As outlined, the NFT component was designed as a prototype testing and onboarding experience to introduce blockchain and Cardano to our Ethiopian community — a population still very early in its exposure to NFTs and wallets.
・During our public launch event, we minted and distributed NFT-enabled NFC cards, in partnership with Endubis Wallet, a local Cardano wallet provider.
・The event included on-site wallet setup, live demonstrations, and hands-on education with attendees, many of whom were engaging with blockchain for the first time.
・Due to the early stage of adoption, follow-up interaction with the blockchain was minimal, but the activity fulfilled its purpose as a pilot and awareness-building phase.
・We collected participant feedback, documented the challenges, and are using those insights to structure deeper educational activities in the next milestones.

This pilot served not only to deliver a technical milestone, but also to bridge real-world onboarding challenges, which we believe will be instrumental for Cardano adoption in East Africa.
